acceptance_criteria.text: Preserve the original three public signatures and compatible behavior. Add production_catalog_entries(base_entries: &[String], ordered_sources: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<Vec<String>, String>; both consumers use the same shared declaration recognition.

Strict compiled/base inventory retains the expected table set, sorted identities, duplicate rejection and exact eight-count semantics for tables, fields, indexes, events, views, sequences, accesses and functions, including existing ACCESS/FUNCTION rejection behavior.

Ordered production overlays retain host source order, plain/OVERWRITE/IF NOT EXISTS forms, optional TABLE after ON, TABLE/FIELD/INDEX/EVENT/FUNCTION/SEQUENCE/ACCESS/ANALYZER/PARAM kinds, unknown-kind errors and identity-set deduplication. Do not impose strict-base counts/duplicate rejection or invent body-replacement semantics.

The actual multiline engine_profile_registry_transition_guard header and equivalent one-line form yield the same exact identity through both public modes. Quoted/commented text, truncated headers and unsupported kinds do not silently invent top-level declarations.

Keep this library std-only and independent of host constants, source ordering, raw-source/catalog hashing, database execution and filesystem/network I/O. Preserve exact identifier and error semantics; this is not a replacement SurrealQL engine.

Owning public-API Cargo tests execute nonzero meaningful cases, actual nonauthor and independent Codecheck review the candidate, normal scoped publication lands it, and an independent canonical remote reread binds immutable source/tree/file pins and source proof before MT211 host writes.
